name: FluidInference/FluidAudio
title: FluidInference/FluidAudio
headline: FluidAudio brings CoreML speech models to Swift apps
lede: Swift developers can add text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice activity detection and speaker diarization using CoreML audio models.

effects.effect: Speech workloads can run on device through CoreML.
Voice features become easier to ship in native apps.

appearances.title: FluidInference/FluidAudio
appearances.summary: Frontier CoreML audio models in your apps ,  text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice activity detection, and speaker diarization. In Swift, powered by SOTA open source.
